'''Kazalie''' (Japanese: '''カザリー''' ''Kazarī'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is a [[Pokémon Performer]].

==History==
Kazalie first appeared in ''[[XY109|Master Class Choices!]]'', where she was first seen competing in the [[Fleurrh City]] Rookie Class [[Pokémon Showcase]]. In the Theme Performance round, she competed against {{an|Serena}} and [[Concetta]], but was unable to proceed.

She reappeared in ''[[XY112|Master Class Is in Session!]]'', where she competed in the Master Class Pokémon Showcase in [[Gloire City]]. However, Kazalie was either eliminated in the first round or the second round.
